source.text: הֶן־כֹּ֭ל רָאֲתָ֣ה עֵינִ֑י שָֽׁמְעָ֥ה אָ֝זְנִ֗י וַתָּ֥בֶן לָֽהּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Look! all [this] has seen my eye; has heard my ear, and has understood it.

en.L: Look, my eye has seen all [this]; \q my ear has heard and understood it.
en.B: Look, my eyes have seen all this; \q my ears have heard it and understood it.
en.R: I have seen all this with my own eyes. \q I have heard it with my own ears, and I understand it.

es.L: He aquí, todo [esto] lo ha visto mi ojo; \q lo ha oído mi oído y lo ha entendido.
es.B: Todo esto lo han visto mis ojos; \q mis oídos lo han oído y lo han entendido.
es.R: Yo he visto todo esto con mis propios ojos. \q Lo he oído con mis propios oídos, y lo entiendo.

fr.L: Voici, mon œil a vu tout [cela] ; \q mon oreille l’a entendu et compris.
fr.B: Voici, mes yeux ont vu tout cela ; \q mes oreilles l’ont entendu et l’ont compris.
fr.R: J’ai vu tout cela de mes propres yeux. \q Je l’ai entendu de mes propres oreilles, et je le comprends.

sw.L: Tazama, jicho langu limeona yote [haya]; \q sikio langu limesikia na kuyaelewa.
sw.B: Tazama, macho yangu yameyaona haya yote; \q masikio yangu yameyasikia na kuyaelewa.
sw.R: Nimeyaona haya yote kwa macho yangu mwenyewe. \q Nimeyasikia kwa masikio yangu mwenyewe, nami nayaelewa.

vi.L: Kìa, mắt tôi đã thấy mọi [điều này]; \q tai tôi đã nghe và hiểu rõ.
vi.B: Này, mắt tôi đã thấy hết mọi điều ấy; \q tai tôi đã nghe và đã hiểu.
vi.R: Chính mắt tôi đã thấy tất cả những điều ấy. \q Chính tai tôi đã nghe, và tôi hiểu rõ.

ko.L: 보시오, 내 눈이 [이] 모든 것을 보았고, \q 내 귀가 듣고 깨달았소.
ko.B: 보시오, 내 눈이 이 모든 것을 보았고, \q 내 귀가 그것을 듣고 깨달았소.
ko.R: 나는 이 모든 것을 내 눈으로 직접 보았소. \q 내 귀로 직접 들었고, 그것을 깨닫고 있소.

pt.L: Eis que tudo [isto] o meu olho viu; \q o meu ouvido ouviu e o entendeu.
pt.B: Vejam, os meus olhos viram tudo isso; \q os meus ouvidos ouviram e entenderam.
pt.R: Eu vi tudo isso com os meus próprios olhos. \q Ouvi com os meus próprios ouvidos, e entendo.

decisions.choice: all this: everything Job has just said about God's power
decisions.reason: Chapter 13 goes on with the reply Job began in 12:1. "All" points back to what he has just described: God's power over animals, waters, counselors, kings and nations (12:7-25). Job is saying he knows it as well as his friends do.

decisions.choice: my eye, my ear: Job's own experience
decisions.reason: Eye and ear stand for Job himself. He has seen and heard these things for himself, set against the friends' appeal to what the old generations taught (8:8-10). He has already said that the ear tests words as the mouth tastes food (12:11).

decisions.choice: eyes ... ears
decisions.reason: Hebrew uses the singular for a part of the body that comes in pairs; English says "eyes" and "ears". Literal keeps the singular.

source.text: כְּֽ֭דַעְתְּכֶם יָדַ֣עְתִּי גַם־אָ֑נִי לֹא־נֹפֵ֖ל אָנֹכִ֣י מִכֶּֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Like your knowledge I know, also I; not falling [am] I from you.

en.L: As you know, I also know; \q I do not fall below you.
en.B: What you know, I know too; \q I am not inferior to you.
en.R: I know as much as you do. \q I am not less wise than you are.

es.L: Como {{plural_you:ustedes saben|vosotros sabéis}}, sé también yo; \q no caigo yo por debajo de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.
es.B: Lo que {{plural_you:ustedes saben|vosotros sabéis}}, lo sé yo también; \q no soy inferior a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.
es.R: Yo sé tanto como {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. \q No soy menos sabio que {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.

fr.L: Ce que vous savez, moi aussi je le sais ; \q je ne tombe pas au-dessous de vous.
fr.B: Ce que vous savez, je le sais aussi ; \q je ne vous suis pas inférieur.
fr.R: J’en sais autant que vous. \q Je ne suis pas moins sage que vous.

sw.L: Kama mjuavyo ninyi, mimi pia najua; \q mimi sianguki chini yenu.
sw.B: Mnachokijua ninyi, nami nakijua; \q mimi si duni kuliko ninyi.
sw.R: Ninajua mengi kama ninyi. \q Sina hekima pungufu kuliko ninyi.

vi.L: Như các anh biết, tôi cũng biết; \q tôi không thua kém các anh.
vi.B: Điều các anh biết, tôi cũng biết; \q tôi chẳng thua kém gì các anh.
vi.R: Tôi biết nhiều như các anh vậy. \q Tôi không kém khôn ngoan hơn các anh.

ko.L: 그대들이 아는 것처럼 나도 아오. \q 나는 그대들보다 못하지 않소.
ko.B: 그대들이 아는 것은 나도 아오. \q 나는 그대들보다 못하지 않소.
ko.R: 나도 그대들만큼 알고 있소. \q 나는 그대들보다 덜 지혜롭지 않소.

pt.L: Como vocês sabem, também eu sei; \q não caio abaixo de vocês.
pt.B: O que vocês sabem, eu também sei; \q não sou inferior a vocês.
pt.R: Eu sei tanto quanto vocês. \q Não sou menos sábio que vocês.

decisions.choice: not falling from you: not inferior to you
alternatives: I do not fail before you
decisions.reason: To "fall from" someone is to fall short of them, to be beneath them. Job used the same words in 12:3. He answers the friends' claim to wisdom (11:6, 12) by saying he knows as much as they do.

decisions.choice: I am not less wise than you are
alternatives: I am not inferior to you
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly in what way Job is not beneath them: in knowledge and wisdom, which is the subject of the verse (m1).

decisions.choice: 하오체 ("그대"/"그대들") only in the lines addressed to the listener; descriptive and proverbial lines in plain 해라체
decisions.reason: Job and his friends speak to each other as respected equals, in 하오체, in the lines one speaker addresses to the other (direct address, questions to him, commands, "you" statements). Lines that describe God, the world or the wicked, proverbs and laments about oneself are in the plain written style (해라체), as Korean poetry reads; Job speaks to God in 합쇼체 with "주님" and "저". Verses 4-13 and 17-19 speak to the three friends ("그대들"); verses 3 and 14-16, where Job speaks of himself and of God, are 해라체; from verse 20 he speaks to God.

source.text: אוּלָ֗ם אֲ֭נִי אֶל־שַׁדַּ֣י אֲדַבֵּ֑ר וְהוֹכֵ֖חַ אֶל־אֵ֣ל אֶחְפָּֽץ׃

records.literal_gloss: But I to [the] Almighty would speak, and to argue with God I desire.

en.L: But I would speak to the Almighty, \q and I desire to argue [my case] with God.
en.B: But I want to speak to the Almighty; \q I long to argue my case with God.
en.R: But I want to speak to God All-Powerful. \q I want to bring my case before God.

es.L: Pero yo hablaría al Todopoderoso, \q y deseo argumentar [mi causa] con Dios.
es.B: Pero quiero hablar con el Todopoderoso; \q anhelo defender mi causa ante Dios.
es.R: Pero quiero hablar con el Dios Todopoderoso. \q Quiero presentar mi caso ante Dios.

fr.L: Mais moi, je voudrais parler au Tout-Puissant, \q et je désire plaider [ma cause] avec Dieu.
fr.B: Mais je veux parler au Tout-Puissant ; \q je désire ardemment plaider ma cause devant Dieu.
fr.R: Mais je veux parler à Dieu le Tout-Puissant. \q Je veux présenter ma cause devant Dieu.

sw.L: Lakini mimi ningesema na Mwenyezi, \q na natamani kujadili [shauri langu] na Mungu.
sw.B: Lakini nataka kusema na Mwenyezi; \q natamani sana kutetea shauri langu mbele za Mungu.
sw.R: Lakini nataka kusema na Mungu Mwenyezi. \q Nataka kupeleka kesi yangu mbele za Mungu.

vi.L: Nhưng tôi muốn thưa với Đấng Toàn Năng, \q và tôi ước ao biện luận [duyên cớ mình] với Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.B: Nhưng tôi muốn thưa chuyện với Đấng Toàn Năng; \q tôi khao khát trình bày duyên cớ mình với Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.R: Nhưng tôi muốn nói chuyện với Đức Chúa Trời Toàn Năng. \q Tôi muốn đem vụ kiện của mình ra trước Đức Chúa Trời.

ko.L: 그러나 나는 전능자께 말씀드리고 싶고, \q 하나님과 [내 사정을] 변론하기를 원한다.
ko.B: 그러나 나는 전능자께 말씀드리고 싶다. \q 하나님 앞에서 내 사정을 변론하기를 간절히 바란다.
ko.R: 그러나 나는 전능하신 하나님께 말씀드리고 싶다. \q 하나님 앞에 내 사정을 내놓고 싶다.

pt.L: Mas eu falaria ao Todo-Poderoso, \q e desejo discutir [a minha causa] com Deus.
pt.B: Mas eu quero falar com o Todo-Poderoso; \q anseio por defender a minha causa diante de Deus.
pt.R: Mas eu quero falar com o Deus Todo-Poderoso. \q Quero apresentar a minha causa a Deus.

decisions.choice: But I: Job turns from the friends to God
decisions.reason: The strong "but" and the stressed "I" set Job against the friends. They talk about God; he wants to talk to God. The rest of the chapter moves from the friends (verses 4-12) to God himself (verses 20-27).

decisions.choice: argue: plead a case in court
decisions.reason: The verb (yakhach) belongs to the law court: to argue a case, to show who is in the right, to correct. It comes again in verse 10 (God will rebuke the friends) and verse 15 (Job will argue his ways before him). Job wants a hearing, not a quarrel.

decisions.choice: the Almighty, God: the names Shaddai and El
decisions.reason: Shaddai is an old name for God, used most of all in Job; it is rendered "the Almighty". El is the common word "God". The two stand in parallel for the one God.

decisions.choice: God All-Powerful
decisions.reason: Readable says "God All-Powerful" for Shaddai, as it does throughout the books from Genesis on.

decisions.choice: argue [my] case
decisions.reason: "My case" is supplied so that the legal sense of the verb is heard (m2).

decisions.choice: « Dieu le Tout-Puissant » (R); « le Tout-Puissant » (L, B) for Shaddai
decisions.reason: Readable names God with the title, as the English "God All-Powerful" and the French of Ruth 1:20.

decisions.choice: "Đức Chúa Trời Toàn Năng" (R); "Đấng Toàn Năng" (L, B) for Shaddai
decisions.reason: Readable names God with the title, as the English "God All-Powerful".

source.text: וְֽאוּלָ֗ם אַתֶּ֥ם טֹֽפְלֵי־שָׁ֑קֶר רֹפְאֵ֖י אֱלִ֣ל כֻּלְּכֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And but you [are] smearers of falsehood; healers of worthlessness [are] all of you.

en.L: But you are smearers of lies; \q worthless healers [are] all of you.
en.B: But you smear things over with lies; \q all of you are worthless physicians.
en.R: As for you, you cover things over with lies. \q You are all like doctors who cannot heal anyone.

es.L: Pero {{plural_you:ustedes son|vosotros sois}} revocadores de mentira; \q médicos inútiles {{plural_you:[son] todos ustedes|[sois] todos vosotros}}.
es.B: Pero {{plural_you:ustedes lo encubren|vosotros lo encubrís}} todo con mentiras; \q todos {{plural_you:ustedes son|vosotros sois}} médicos que no sirven para nada.
es.R: En cuanto a {{plural_you:ustedes, cubren|vosotros, cubrís}} las cosas con mentiras. \q Todos {{plural_you:ustedes son|vosotros sois}} como médicos que no curan a nadie.

fr.L: Mais vous, vous êtes des badigeonneurs de mensonge ; \q des médecins de néant, [voilà ce que] vous êtes tous.
fr.B: Mais vous, vous recouvrez tout de mensonges ; \q vous êtes tous des médecins qui ne valent rien.
fr.R: Quant à vous, vous cachez la vérité sous des mensonges. \q Vous êtes tous comme des médecins qui ne guérissent personne.

sw.L: Lakini ninyi ni wapakaji wa uongo; \q nyote [ni] waganga wasiofaa kitu.
sw.B: Lakini ninyi mnafunika mambo kwa uongo; \q nyote ni waganga wasio na faida.
sw.R: Ama ninyi, mnafunika ukweli kwa uongo. \q Nyote mko kama waganga wasioweza kumponya mtu yeyote.

vi.L: Nhưng các anh là những kẻ trét lời dối trá; \q tất cả các anh [là] những thầy thuốc vô dụng.
vi.B: Nhưng các anh lấy lời dối trá mà che phủ mọi điều; \q tất cả các anh đều là thầy thuốc vô dụng.
vi.R: Còn các anh, các anh dùng lời dối trá để che đậy sự thật. \q Các anh đều như những thầy thuốc chẳng chữa lành được ai.

ko.L: 그러나 그대들은 거짓을 바르는 자들이요, \q 그대들은 다 쓸모없는 의원들이오.
ko.B: 그러나 그대들은 거짓말로 덧칠하는 자들이오. \q 그대들은 모두 쓸모없는 의사들이오.
ko.R: 그대들은 거짓말로 진실을 덮어 버리오. \q 그대들은 모두 아무도 고치지 못하는 의사 같소.

pt.L: Mas vocês são rebocadores de mentiras; \q médicos inúteis [são] todos vocês.
pt.B: Mas vocês encobrem as coisas com mentiras; \q todos vocês são médicos que não servem para nada.
pt.R: Quanto a vocês, vocês tapam a verdade com mentiras. \q Vocês são como médicos que não conseguem curar ninguém.

decisions.choice: smearers of falsehood: people who plaster lies over the truth
alternatives: people who smear me with lies
decisions.reason: The verb (tafal) means to smear or plaster a surface. Job pictures the friends coating the facts with falsehood, as a builder covers a wall; the same verb comes in 14:17. In Psalm 119:69 the arrogant "smear" a faithful man with lies, so the friends may also be daubing Job with false charges.

decisions.choice: healers of worthlessness: physicians who cannot heal
decisions.reason: The word ('elil) means something empty and useless; it is also a word for idols (Leviticus 19:4). The friends came to comfort Job (2:11), but their treatment does no good.

decisions.choice: like doctors who cannot heal anyone
decisions.reason: Readable spells out the picture: the friends are like doctors whose cure does nothing (m2).

source.text: מִֽי־יִ֭תֵּן הַחֲרֵ֣שׁ תַּחֲרִישׁ֑וּן וּתְהִ֖י לָכֶ֣ם לְחָכְמָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Who will give [that] being silent you would be silent, and it would be for you for wisdom.

en.L: Oh that you would be completely silent, \q and it would be wisdom for you!
en.B: If only you would keep completely silent! \q That would be wisdom on your part.
en.R: If only you would all just be quiet! \q That would be the wise thing for you to do.

es.L: ¡Oh, si {{plural_you:callaran|callarais}} del todo, \q y eso {{plural_you:les|os}} sería [contado] por sabiduría!
es.B: ¡Ojalá {{plural_you:guardaran|guardarais}} completo silencio! \q Eso sería sabiduría de {{plural_you:parte de ustedes|vuestra parte}}.
es.R: ¡Si tan solo {{plural_you:se callaran|os callarais}} todos! \q Eso sería lo más sabio que {{plural_you:podrían|podríais}} hacer.

fr.L: Oh ! si vous gardiez un complet silence, \q et ce serait pour vous de la sagesse !
fr.B: Si seulement vous vous taisiez complètement ! \q Ce serait de la sagesse de votre part.
fr.R: Si seulement vous vous taisiez tous ! \q Ce serait la chose la plus sage à faire.

sw.L: Laiti mngenyamaza kabisa, \q na hilo lingekuwa hekima kwenu!
sw.B: Laiti mngenyamaza kimya kabisa! \q Hiyo ingekuwa hekima kwenu.
sw.R: Laiti nyote mngenyamaza tu! \q Hilo lingekuwa jambo la busara kwenu.

vi.L: Ôi, ước gì các anh hoàn toàn im lặng, \q thì điều đó sẽ là khôn ngoan cho các anh!
vi.B: Ước gì các anh cứ im lặng hẳn! \q Như thế mới là khôn ngoan.
vi.R: Giá mà các anh chịu im lặng! \q Đó mới là điều khôn ngoan các anh nên làm.

ko.L: 그대들이 잠잠하고 또 잠잠하기를 바라오. \q 그것이 그대들에게 지혜가 될 것이오!
ko.B: 그대들이 아예 입을 다물었으면 좋겠소! \q 그것이 그대들의 지혜일 것이오.
ko.R: 그대들 모두 그냥 조용히 있으면 좋겠소! \q 그것이 그대들이 할 수 있는 가장 지혜로운 일이오.

pt.L: Quem dera vocês se calassem de todo, \q e isso seria sabedoria para vocês!
pt.B: Se ao menos vocês ficassem completamente calados! \q Isso seria sabedoria da parte de vocês.
pt.R: Se ao menos vocês todos ficassem quietos! \q Essa seria a coisa mais sábia que poderiam fazer.

decisions.choice: Who will give: a wish, "if only"
decisions.reason: "Who will give ...?" is the usual Hebrew way to express a wish (6:8; 11:5; 14:13). It is not a question about any person.

decisions.choice: being silent you would be silent: complete silence
decisions.reason: The verb is repeated in two forms for emphasis. When the friends first came they sat with Job seven days in silence (2:13); Job wishes they had stayed that way.

decisions.choice: silence would be wisdom
decisions.reason: The thought is a proverb: even a fool who keeps silent is counted wise (Proverbs 17:28). The friends claim to speak wisdom (11:6); Job says their wisest course would be to say nothing.

source.text: שִׁמְעוּ־נָ֥א תוֹכַחְתִּ֑י וְרִב֖וֹת שְׂפָתַ֣י הַקְשִֽׁיבוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Hear please my argument, and to [the] pleas of my lips pay attention.

en.L: Hear now my argument, \q and pay attention to the pleas of my lips.
en.B: Please listen to my argument; \q pay attention to the case I plead.
en.R: Now listen to my side of the case. \q Pay attention to what I am arguing.

es.L: {{plural_you:Oigan|Oíd}} ahora mi argumento, \q y {{plural_you:atiendan|atended}} a los alegatos de mis labios.
es.B: Por favor, {{plural_you:escuchen|escuchad}} mi argumento; \q {{plural_you:presten|prestad}} atención a la causa que defiendo.
es.R: Ahora {{plural_you:escuchen|escuchad}} mi versión del caso. \q {{plural_you:Pongan|Poned}} atención a lo que argumento.

fr.L: Écoutez donc mon argument, \q et soyez attentifs aux plaidoiries de mes lèvres.
fr.B: Écoutez, je vous prie, mon argumentation ; \q soyez attentifs à la cause que je plaide.
fr.R: Maintenant, écoutez ma version de l’affaire. \q Faites attention à ce que je défends.

sw.L: Sikieni sasa hoja yangu, \q na msikilize maombi ya midomo yangu.
sw.B: Tafadhali sikilizeni hoja yangu; \q zingatieni shauri ninalolitetea.
sw.R: Sasa sikilizeni upande wangu wa kesi. \q Zingatieni ninachokitetea.

vi.L: Xin hãy nghe lời biện luận của tôi, \q và lắng tai nghe lời biện hộ của môi tôi.
vi.B: Xin các anh nghe lý lẽ của tôi; \q hãy chú ý đến duyên cớ tôi bênh vực.
vi.R: Bây giờ hãy nghe tôi trình bày phần của tôi. \q Hãy chú ý đến những gì tôi biện luận.

ko.L: 이제 나의 논증을 들으시오. \q 내 입술의 변론에 귀를 기울이시오.
ko.B: 부디 내 논증을 들어 보시오. \q 내가 변론하는 것에 귀를 기울이시오.
ko.R: 이제 내 쪽 이야기를 들어 보시오. \q 내가 주장하는 것을 잘 들으시오.

pt.L: Ouçam agora o meu argumento \q e prestem atenção às alegações dos meus lábios.
pt.B: Por favor, ouçam o meu argumento; \q prestem atenção à causa que defendo.
pt.R: Agora escutem o meu lado da questão. \q Prestem atenção ao que eu estou argumentando.

decisions.choice: argument, pleas: the words of a court case
decisions.reason: The first word (tokhachat) comes from the verb "argue" of verse 3 and means a reasoned case or a correction. The second (rivot) is the plural of the word for a lawsuit (rib). Job speaks as a man presenting his case.

decisions.choice: the case I plead
decisions.reason: Balanced puts "the pleas of my lips" in plain English as "the case I plead"; Literal keeps the lips.

source.text: הַ֭לְאֵל תְּדַבְּר֣וּ עַוְלָ֑ה וְ֝ל֗וֹ תְּֽדַבְּר֥וּ רְמִיָּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: ? For God will you speak wrong, and for him will you speak deceit?

en.L: Will you speak injustice for God, \q and for {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} speak deceit?
en.B: Will you speak what is unjust on God's behalf, \q and say what is false for {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}?
en.R: Will you tell lies to defend God? \q Will you twist the truth to take {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} side?

es.L: ¿{{plural_you:Hablarán|Hablaréis}} injusticia por Dios, \q y por {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} {{plural_you:hablarán|hablaréis}} engaño?
es.B: ¿{{plural_you:Dirán|Diréis}} lo injusto en favor de Dios, \q y lo falso en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} favor?
es.R: ¿{{plural_you:Van|Vais}} a mentir para defender a Dios? \q ¿{{plural_you:Van|Vais}} a torcer la verdad para {{plural_you:ponerse|poneros}} de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} lado?

fr.L: Direz-vous l’injustice pour Dieu, \q et pour {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} direz-vous la tromperie ?
fr.B: Direz-vous ce qui est injuste en faveur de Dieu, \q et ce qui est faux pour {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} ?
fr.R: Allez-vous mentir pour défendre Dieu ? \q Allez-vous tordre la vérité pour prendre {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} parti ?

sw.L: Je, mtasema udhalimu kwa ajili ya Mungu, \q na kwa ajili {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} mtasema hila?
sw.B: Je, mtasema yasiyo ya haki kwa niaba ya Mungu, \q na kusema uongo kwa ajili {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}?
sw.R: Je, mtasema uongo ili kumtetea Mungu? \q Je, mtapotosha ukweli ili kuwa upande {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}?

vi.L: Các anh sẽ nói điều bất công vì Đức Chúa Trời sao, \q và vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mà nói điều dối trá sao?
vi.B: Các anh sẽ nói điều bất công để bênh vực Đức Chúa Trời, \q và nói điều giả dối thay cho {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sao?
vi.R: Các anh sẽ nói dối để bênh vực Đức Chúa Trời sao? \q Các anh sẽ bóp méo sự thật để đứng về phía {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sao?

ko.L: 그대들이 하나님을 위하여 불의를 말하겠소? \q 그분을 위하여 속임수를 말하겠소?
ko.B: 그대들이 하나님 편에서 불의한 말을 하고, \q 그분을 위해 거짓을 말하겠소?
ko.R: 그대들은 하나님을 변호하려고 거짓말을 하겠소? \q 그분 편을 들려고 진실을 비틀겠소?

pt.L: Vocês falarão injustiça por Deus \q e por {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} falarão engano?
pt.B: Vocês vão dizer o que é injusto em favor de Deus \q e falar mentiras por {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}?
pt.R: Vocês vão mentir para defender Deus? \q Vão torcer a verdade para ficar do lado {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}?

decisions.choice: for God, for him: on God's behalf
decisions.reason: The preposition here means "on behalf of". The friends act as God's advocates, defending his justice by claiming Job must be guilty. Job asks whether God needs to be defended with falsehood.

decisions.choice: injustice, deceit
decisions.reason: The first word ('avlah) is wrongdoing, here an unjust verdict or claim; the second (remiyyah) is deceit, a lie meant to mislead. The friends' case against Job rests on what is not true.

decisions.choice: tell lies ... twist the truth
decisions.reason: Readable puts the two nouns as plain verbs of false speech (m2) and says "defend" and "take his side" for speaking on God's behalf (m1).

source.text: הֲפָנָ֥יו תִּשָּׂא֑וּן אִם־לָאֵ֥ל תְּרִיבֽוּן׃

records.literal_gloss: ? His face will you lift up? Or for God will you contend?

en.L: Will you lift up {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} face? \q Or will you contend for God?
en.B: Will you show {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} partiality? \q Will you plead the case for God?
en.R: Will you take {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} side unfairly? \q Will you argue God's case for {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}?

es.L: ¿{{plural_you:Alzarán|Alzaréis}} {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} rostro? \q ¿O {{plural_you:contenderán|contenderéis}} por Dios?
es.B: ¿{{plural_you:Mostrarán|Mostraréis}} parcialidad hacia {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}? \q ¿{{plural_you:Defenderán|Defenderéis}} la causa de Dios?
es.R: ¿{{plural_you:Van a ponerse|Vais a poneros}} de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} lado injustamente? \q ¿{{plural_you:Van|Vais}} a defender la causa de Dios por {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}?

fr.L: Lèverez-vous {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} face ? \q Ou plaiderez-vous pour Dieu ?
fr.B: Ferez-vous preuve de partialité envers {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} ? \q Plaiderez-vous la cause de Dieu ?
fr.R: Allez-vous prendre {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} parti injustement ? \q Allez-vous défendre la cause de Dieu à {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} place ?

sw.L: Je, mtauinua uso {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}? \q Au mtamtetea Mungu?
sw.B: Je, mtampendelea {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}}? \q Je, mtalitetea shauri la Mungu?
sw.R: Je, mtakuwa upande {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} bila haki? \q Je, mtamtetea Mungu kwa niaba {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}?

vi.L: Các anh sẽ nâng mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} lên sao? \q Hay các anh sẽ tranh luận cho Đức Chúa Trời?
vi.B: Các anh sẽ thiên vị {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sao? \q Các anh sẽ biện hộ cho Đức Chúa Trời sao?
vi.R: Các anh sẽ đứng về phía {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} một cách bất công sao? \q Các anh sẽ thay {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mà cãi lý cho Đức Chúa Trời sao?

ko.L: 그대들이 그분의 얼굴을 들어 주겠소? \q 하나님을 위하여 다투겠소?
ko.B: 그대들이 그분을 편들겠소? \q 하나님을 위해 변론하겠소?
ko.R: 그대들이 불공평하게 그분 편을 들겠소? \q 그대들이 하나님을 대신해 하나님의 사정을 변호하겠소?

pt.L: Vocês levantarão o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} rosto? \q Ou contenderão por Deus?
pt.B: Vocês vão mostrar parcialidade a favor {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}? \q Vão advogar a causa de Deus?
pt.R: Vocês vão tomar o partido {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}} de forma injusta? \q Vão defender a causa de Deus por {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}?

decisions.choice: lift up his face: show partiality
decisions.reason: To "lift up the face" of someone in a court is to favor that person, which the law forbids (Leviticus 19:15); God himself shows no partiality (Deuteronomy 10:17). Job charges the friends with favoring God the way a corrupt judge favors the powerful, rather than judging fairly.

decisions.choice: contend: argue a case as an advocate
decisions.reason: The verb (rib) means to plead or argue a legal case. The friends have made themselves God's lawyers.

source.text: הֲ֭טוֹב כִּֽי־יַחְקֹ֣ר אֶתְכֶ֑ם אִם־כְּהָתֵ֥ל בֶּ֝אֱנ֗וֹשׁ תְּהָתֵ֥לּוּ בֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: ? Good [will it be] that he searches you? Or as one deceives a man will you deceive him?

en.L: Will it be good when {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} searches you out? \q Or as one deceives a man, will you deceive {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}?
en.B: Would it go well for you if {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} examined you? \q Can you fool {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} as you would fool a mortal?
en.R: What will happen when God looks closely at you? \q Do you think you can fool {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} the way you fool people?

es.L: ¿Será bueno cuando {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} {{plural_you:los|os}} escudriñe? \q ¿O como se engaña a un hombre, {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} {{plural_you:engañarán|engañaréis}}?
es.B: ¿{{plural_you:Les|Os}} iría bien si {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} {{plural_you:los|os}} examinara? \q ¿Acaso {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} {{plural_you:pueden|podéis}} engañar como se engaña a un mortal?
es.R: ¿Qué pasará cuando Dios {{plural_you:los|os}} examine de cerca? \q ¿{{plural_you:Creen|Creéis}} que {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} {{plural_you:pueden|podéis}} engañar como {{plural_you:engañan|engañáis}} a la gente?

fr.L: Sera-ce bon quand {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} vous sondera ? \q Ou, comme on trompe un homme, {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} tromperez-vous ?
fr.B: Cela irait-il bien pour vous s’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} vous examinait ? \q Pouvez-vous {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} duper comme on dupe un mortel ?
fr.R: Que se passera-t-il quand Dieu vous examinera de près ? \q Pensez-vous pouvoir {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} tromper comme vous trompez les gens ?

sw.L: Je, itakuwa vyema {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} atakapowachunguza? \q Au kama mtu amdanganyavyo mwanadamu, mtamdanganya {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}}?
sw.B: Je, mngefanikiwa kama angewachunguza? \q Je, mnaweza kumdanganya {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} kama mnavyomdanganya mwanadamu?
sw.R: Itakuwaje Mungu atakapowachunguza kwa makini? \q Mnadhani mnaweza kumdanganya {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} kama mnavyowadanganya watu?

vi.L: Sẽ tốt chăng khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} dò xét các anh? \q Hay như người ta lừa một người phàm, các anh sẽ lừa {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sao?
vi.B: Các anh có được yên ổn không nếu {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} tra xét các anh? \q Các anh có thể đánh lừa {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} như đánh lừa người phàm sao?
vi.R: Điều gì sẽ xảy ra khi Đức Chúa Trời xem xét kỹ các anh? \q Các anh nghĩ có thể lừa {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} như lừa người ta sao?

ko.L: 그분께서 그대들을 살피실 때 좋겠소? \q 사람을 속이듯 그대들이 그분을 속이겠소?
ko.B: 그분께서 그대들을 샅샅이 살피시면 그대들에게 좋겠소? \q 사람을 속이듯 그분을 속일 수 있겠소?
ko.R: 하나님께서 그대들을 자세히 살피시면 어떻게 되겠소? \q 사람들을 속이듯이 그분을 속일 수 있다고 생각하오?

pt.L: Será bom quando {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} os esquadrinhar? \q Ou, como se engana um homem, vocês {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} enganarão?
pt.B: Seria bom para vocês se {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} os examinasse? \q Vocês conseguem enganá-{{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} como enganariam um mortal?
pt.R: O que vai acontecer quando Deus examinar vocês de perto? \q Vocês acham que podem enganá-{{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} como enganam as pessoas?

decisions.choice: searches: examines closely
decisions.reason: The verb (chaqar) means to search out or investigate, as God searches the heart (Psalm 139:1, 23). If God examined the friends' own motives, the result would not be good for them.

decisions.choice: deceive: fool, trick
decisions.reason: The verb (hatel) means to trick or make a fool of someone (Genesis 31:7). A person can be fooled by a clever argument; God cannot.

decisions.choice: God
decisions.reason: Readable names God, since a new sentence begins and "he" could be unclear.

source.text: הוֹכֵ֣חַ יוֹכִ֣יחַ אֶתְכֶ֑ם אִם־בַּ֝סֵּ֗תֶר פָּנִ֥ים תִּשָּׂאֽוּן׃

records.literal_gloss: Rebuking he will rebuke you if in secret faces you lift up.

en.L: He will surely rebuke you \q if in secret you lift up faces.
en.B: He will certainly rebuke you \q if you secretly show partiality.
en.R: God will surely correct you \q if you secretly take sides.

es.L: Ciertamente {{plural_you:los|os}} reprenderá \q si en secreto {{plural_you:alzan|alzáis}} rostros.
es.B: Sin duda {{plural_you:los|os}} reprenderá \q si en secreto {{plural_you:muestran|mostráis}} parcialidad.
es.R: Dios de seguro {{plural_you:los|os}} corregirá \q si en secreto {{plural_you:toman|tomáis}} partido.

fr.L: Il vous réprimandera sûrement, \q si en secret vous levez des visages.
fr.B: Il vous reprendra sévèrement \q si vous êtes partiaux en secret.
fr.R: Dieu vous corrigera sûrement \q si vous prenez parti en secret.

sw.L: Hakika atawakemea \q kama kwa siri mtainua nyuso.
sw.B: Hakika atawakemea \q kama mtapendelea kwa siri.
sw.R: Hakika Mungu atawarekebisha \q kama mtakuwa upande mmoja kwa siri.

vi.L: Ngài ắt sẽ quở trách các anh \q nếu các anh lén lút nâng mặt [ai].
vi.B: Ngài chắc chắn sẽ khiển trách các anh \q nếu các anh lén lút thiên vị.
vi.R: Đức Chúa Trời chắc chắn sẽ sửa phạt các anh \q nếu các anh lén lút đứng về một phía.

ko.L: 그분께서 반드시 그대들을 책망하실 것이오, \q 그대들이 은밀히 얼굴을 들어 준다면.
ko.B: 그분께서 반드시 그대들을 꾸짖으실 것이오. \q 그대들이 몰래 한쪽 편을 든다면 말이오.
ko.R: 하나님께서 틀림없이 그대들을 바로잡으실 것이오. \q 그대들이 몰래 편을 든다면 말이오.

pt.L: Ele certamente os repreenderá \q se em segredo vocês levantarem rostos.
pt.B: Ele com certeza vai repreender vocês \q se em segredo mostrarem parcialidade.
pt.R: Deus certamente vai corrigir vocês \q se tomarem partido às escondidas.

decisions.choice: surely rebuke: the verb of verse 3, repeated for emphasis
decisions.reason: The verb is yakhach, "argue, correct", which Job used of his own wish to argue with God (verse 3). Here it is doubled for emphasis: God will turn the case on the friends. The book ends this way, when God rebukes them (42:7).

decisions.choice: lift up faces: show partiality, as in verse 8
decisions.reason: The idiom of verse 8 returns. Even partiality kept secret, in the friends' own hearts, would be judged.

decisions.choice: God
decisions.reason: Readable names God for clarity.

decisions.choice: The condition follows the main clause, "... 꾸짖으실 것이오. 그대들이 ... 든다면 말이오."
decisions.reason: Korean puts a condition first; keeping the English line order needs the trailing "... 말이오".

source.text: הֲלֹ֣א שְׂ֭אֵתוֹ תְּבַעֵ֣ת אֶתְכֶ֑ם וּ֝פַחְדּ֗וֹ יִפֹּ֥ל עֲלֵיכֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: ? Not his majesty will terrify you, and his dread fall on you?

en.L: Will not {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} majesty terrify you, \q and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} dread fall on you?
en.B: Will {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} majesty not fill you with terror? \q Will the dread of {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} not fall on you?
en.R: Should God's greatness not make you afraid? \q Should fear of {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} not come over you?

es.L: ¿No {{plural_you:los|os}} aterrará {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} majestad, \q y {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pavor caerá sobre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}?
es.B: ¿No {{plural_you:los|os}} llenará de terror {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} majestad? \q ¿No caerá sobre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} el temor de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}?
es.R: ¿No {{plural_you:les|os}} debería dar miedo la grandeza de Dios? \q ¿No debería venir sobre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} el temor de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}?

fr.L: Est-ce que {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} majesté ne vous terrifiera pas, \q et que {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} frayeur ne tombera pas sur vous ?
fr.B: Ne serez-vous pas terrifiés par {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} majesté ? \q La terreur qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} inspire ne tombera-t-elle pas sur vous ?
fr.R: La grandeur de Dieu ne devrait-elle pas vous faire peur ? \q La crainte de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} ne devrait-elle pas vous saisir ?

sw.L: Je, utukufu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} hautawatisha, \q na hofu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} haitawaangukia?
sw.B: Je, ukuu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} hautawajaza hofu? \q Je, kitisho {{deity_pronoun:chake|Chake}} hakitawaangukia?
sw.R: Je, ukuu wa Mungu usiwatie hofu? \q Je, hofu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} isiwajie?

vi.L: Chẳng lẽ sự uy nghiêm của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} không làm các anh kinh hãi, \q và sự kinh khiếp của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} không giáng trên các anh sao?
vi.B: Sự uy nghiêm của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} không làm các anh khiếp sợ sao? \q Nỗi kinh hãi về {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} không giáng trên các anh sao?
vi.R: Sự vĩ đại của Đức Chúa Trời không làm các anh sợ sao? \q Các anh không kính sợ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sao?

ko.L: 그분의 위엄이 그대들을 두렵게 하지 않겠소? \q 그분의 두려움이 그대들에게 임하지 않겠소?
ko.B: 그분의 위엄이 그대들을 떨게 하지 않겠소? \q 그분에 대한 두려움이 그대들에게 닥치지 않겠소?
ko.R: 하나님의 크심을 보고 그대들은 두렵지 않소? \q 그분을 두려워하는 마음이 그대들에게 생기지 않소?

pt.L: Não os aterrorizará a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} majestade, \q e o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} pavor não cairá sobre vocês?
pt.B: A {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} majestade não vai encher vocês de terror? \q O pavor {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}} não vai cair sobre vocês?
pt.R: A grandeza de Deus não deveria deixar vocês com medo? \q O temor {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}} não deveria tomar conta de vocês?

decisions.choice: majesty: God's exalted greatness
decisions.reason: The word (se'et) comes from the verb "lift up" (nasa), the verb of "lift up the face" in verses 8 and 10. The friends "lift up" God's face by taking his side; Job warns that his own "lifting up", his majesty, should terrify them.

decisions.choice: dread: the fear that God's presence brings
decisions.reason: The word (pachad) is sudden fear or terror. Job knows this fear himself (3:25; 9:34) and asks why the friends, who speak for God so freely, show none of it.

decisions.choice: God's greatness
decisions.reason: Readable names God and uses the plain word "greatness" (m1).

source.text: זִֽ֭כְרֹנֵיכֶם מִשְׁלֵי־אֵ֑פֶר לְגַבֵּי־חֹ֝֗מֶר גַּבֵּיכֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Your memorials [are] proverbs of ashes; to defenses of clay [are] your defenses.

en.L: Your memorable sayings [are] proverbs of ashes; \q your defenses [are] defenses of clay.
en.B: Your wise sayings are proverbs made of ashes; \q your defenses are defenses of clay.
en.R: The sayings you remember are as useless as ashes. \q Your arguments crumble like clay.

es.L: {{plural_you:Sus|Vuestros}} dichos memorables [son] proverbios de ceniza; \q {{plural_you:sus|vuestras}} defensas [son] defensas de barro.
es.B: {{plural_you:Sus|Vuestros}} sabios dichos son proverbios de ceniza; \q {{plural_you:sus|vuestras}} defensas son defensas de barro.
es.R: Los dichos que {{plural_you:ustedes recuerdan|vosotros recordáis}} valen lo mismo que la ceniza. \q {{plural_you:Sus|Vuestros}} argumentos se deshacen como el barro.

fr.L: Vos sentences mémorables [sont] des proverbes de cendre ; \q vos défenses [sont] des défenses d’argile.
fr.B: Vos maximes sont des proverbes de cendre ; \q vos défenses sont des défenses d’argile.
fr.R: Les maximes que vous répétez ne valent pas plus que de la cendre. \q Vos arguments s’effritent comme de l’argile.

sw.L: Kumbukumbu zenu [ni] mithali za majivu; \q ngome zenu [ni] ngome za udongo.
sw.B: Misemo yenu ya hekima ni mithali za majivu; \q ngome zenu ni ngome za udongo.
sw.R: Misemo mnayoikumbuka haifai kitu, kama majivu. \q Hoja zenu zinabomoka kama udongo.

vi.L: Những châm ngôn đáng nhớ của các anh [là] châm ngôn bằng tro; \q những lũy che chắn của các anh [là] lũy bằng đất sét.
vi.B: Những câu cách ngôn khôn ngoan của các anh là châm ngôn bằng tro; \q những lời bào chữa của các anh là thành lũy bằng đất sét.
vi.R: Những câu nói các anh nhớ thuộc lòng chẳng có giá trị gì, như tro bụi. \q Lý lẽ của các anh vỡ vụn như đất sét.

ko.L: 그대들의 격언은 재의 속담이요, \q 그대들의 방어는 진흙의 방어요.
ko.B: 그대들의 지혜로운 말은 재로 만든 속담이요, \q 그대들의 방어벽은 진흙으로 쌓은 방어벽이오.
ko.R: 그대들이 외우는 격언은 재처럼 쓸모없소. \q 그대들의 주장은 진흙처럼 부서져 버리오.

pt.L: Os ditos memoráveis de vocês [são] provérbios de cinza; \q as defesas de vocês [são] defesas de barro.
pt.B: Os ditados sábios de vocês são provérbios de cinza; \q as defesas de vocês são defesas de barro.
pt.R: Os ditados que vocês repetem são inúteis como cinza. \q Os argumentos de vocês se esfarelam como barro.

decisions.choice: memorials: sayings handed down and remembered
decisions.reason: The word (zikkaron) is something kept in memory. Here it means the maxims the friends quote from the wisdom of the past (8:8-10), which they offer as if they settled Job's case.

decisions.choice: defenses: mounds or shield bosses, the strong points of an argument
decisions.reason: The word (gav) means a back or a raised mound, and is used of the boss of a shield (15:26). The picture is of a defense that should be solid but is made of clay. The exact image is uncertain, but the sense is clear: the friends' arguments will not stand.

decisions.choice: ashes, clay: worthless and crumbling
decisions.reason: Ashes blow away and dried clay breaks. Both stand for what has no strength or worth (Isaiah 44:20).

decisions.choice: Your arguments crumble like clay
alternatives: your defenses are defenses of clay
decisions.reason: Readable says what the picture means: the friends' arguments fall apart (m2, m3).

source.text: הַחֲרִ֣ישׁוּ מִ֭מֶּנִּי וַאֲדַבְּרָה־אָ֑נִי וְיַעֲבֹ֖ר עָלַ֣י מָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Be silent from me, and let me speak, I; and let pass over me whatever.

en.L: Be silent from me, and let me speak, [even] I; \q and let pass over me whatever [may].
en.B: Be quiet and leave me alone, so that I may speak; \q then let come on me what may.
en.R: Stop talking and let me speak. \q After that, whatever happens to me will happen.

es.L: {{plural_you:Callen|Callad}} ante mí, y hablaré yo; \q y que venga sobre mí lo que [sea].
es.B: {{plural_you:Cállense y déjenme|Callaos y dejadme}} en paz, para que yo hable; \q luego, que venga sobre mí lo que venga.
es.R: {{plural_you:Dejen|Dejad}} de hablar y {{plural_you:déjenme|dejadme}} hablar. \q Después, que me pase lo que me tenga que pasar.

fr.L: Taisez-vous [loin] de moi, et que je parle, moi ; \q et que m’arrive ce qui [voudra].
fr.B: Taisez-vous, laissez-moi, que je puisse parler ; \q puis advienne de moi que pourra.
fr.R: Arrêtez de parler et laissez-moi parler. \q Après cela, il m’arrivera ce qui doit arriver.

sw.L: Nyamazeni mbali nami, ili mimi niseme; \q na linipate lolote [litakalokuja].
sw.B: Nyamazeni, mniache, ili niseme; \q kisha na linijie lolote litakalokuja.
sw.R: Acheni kusema, mniache niseme. \q Baada ya hapo, lolote litakalonipata na linipate.

vi.L: Hãy im lặng [mà để] tôi yên, để chính tôi được nói; \q rồi điều gì [đến] trên tôi cũng mặc.
vi.B: Hãy im lặng và để tôi yên, để tôi nói; \q rồi chuyện gì đến với tôi thì cứ đến.
vi.R: Hãy thôi nói và để tôi nói. \q Sau đó, điều gì xảy đến với tôi cũng được.

ko.L: 내게서 잠잠하고 [나로] 말하게 하시오. \q 무엇이 내게 닥치든지 [닥치게 두시오].
ko.B: 잠잠하고 나를 내버려 두시오. 내가 말하겠소. \q 그다음에는 무슨 일이 닥쳐도 좋소.
ko.R: 말을 그치고 내가 말하게 해 주시오. \q 그 뒤에 무슨 일이 일어나든 상관없소.

pt.L: Calem-se diante de mim, e deixem-me falar, [sim,] eu; \q e venha sobre mim o que [vier].
pt.B: Fiquem quietos e me deixem em paz, para que eu possa falar; \q depois, venha sobre mim o que vier.
pt.R: Parem de falar e me deixem falar. \q Depois disso, o que tiver de acontecer comigo vai acontecer.

decisions.choice: be silent from me: stop talking at me, leave me alone
decisions.reason: The same verb as verse 5 ("be silent") is used with "from me": the friends are to turn their speech away from Job and let him have his turn.

decisions.choice: let pass over me whatever: let come what may
decisions.reason: Job knows that speaking to God this way may cost him his life (verses 14-15, 19). He accepts whatever comes.

decisions.choice: leave me alone
decisions.reason: Balanced adds "leave me alone" to give the sense of "from me" (m1).

source.text: עַל־מָ֤ה׀אֶשָּׂ֣א בְשָׂרִ֣י בְשִׁנָּ֑י וְ֝נַפְשִׁ֗י אָשִׂ֥ים בְּכַפִּֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: On what will I take my flesh in my teeth, and my life put in my palm?

en.L: Why should I take my flesh in my teeth, \q and put my life in my palm?
en.B: Why should I take my flesh in my teeth \q and put my life in my hands?
en.R: Why should I put myself in danger like this, \q taking my life into my own hands?

es.L: ¿Por qué tomaré mi carne entre mis dientes, \q y pondré mi vida en mi palma?
es.B: ¿Por qué he de tomar mi carne entre los dientes \q y poner mi vida en mis manos?
es.R: ¿Por qué tendría que ponerme en peligro así, \q jugándome la vida?

fr.L: Pourquoi prendrais-je ma chair entre mes dents, \q et mettrais-je ma vie dans ma paume ?
fr.B: Pourquoi prendrais-je ma chair entre mes dents \q et mettrais-je ma vie entre mes mains ?
fr.R: Pourquoi me mettrais-je ainsi en danger, \q en risquant ma propre vie ?

sw.L: Kwa nini niichukue nyama yangu kwa meno yangu, \q na kuuweka uhai wangu katika kiganja changu?
sw.B: Kwa nini niichukue nyama yangu kwa meno yangu \q na kuuweka uhai wangu mikononi mwangu?
sw.R: Kwa nini nijitie hatarini namna hii, \q nikihatarisha maisha yangu mwenyewe?

vi.L: Tại sao tôi phải cắn thịt mình trong răng, \q và đặt mạng sống mình trong lòng bàn tay?
vi.B: Tại sao tôi phải lấy răng cắn lấy thịt mình \q và đặt mạng sống mình trong tay mình?
vi.R: Tại sao tôi phải tự đặt mình vào nguy hiểm như vậy, \q liều cả mạng sống mình?

ko.L: 어찌하여 내가 내 살을 내 이로 물고, \q 내 목숨을 내 손바닥에 두겠는가?
ko.B: 어찌하여 내가 내 살을 이로 물고 \q 내 목숨을 내 손에 두겠는가?
ko.R: 어찌하여 내가 이렇게 위험을 무릅쓰고 \q 내 목숨을 걸어야 하는가?

pt.L: Por que tomaria eu a minha carne nos meus dentes \q e poria a minha vida na palma da minha mão?
pt.B: Por que eu levaria a minha carne entre os dentes \q e poria a minha vida nas minhas mãos?
pt.R: Por que eu me arriscaria desse jeito, \q pondo a minha vida em jogo?

decisions.choice: flesh in my teeth, life in my palm: to risk one's life
decisions.reason: To put one's life in one's hand is to risk it (Judges 12:3; 1 Samuel 19:5; 28:21). Flesh held in the teeth is like prey in an animal's mouth, which may be lost at any moment. Both lines mean that Job is putting his life at risk by bringing his case to God.

decisions.choice: Why: kept as the Hebrew text has it
alternatives: no "why": "I will take my flesh in my teeth and put my life in my hand"
decisions.reason: The verse begins "on what?", that is "why?", and verse 13 ends with the same word "what". Many take the word here as written twice by mistake; without it the verse is a statement of Job's resolve: "I will take my flesh in my teeth." The Hebrew as it stands asks why he should take the risk, and the answer follows in verses 15-16. Either way Job is ready to risk his life.

decisions.choice: hands
decisions.reason: Balanced says "hands", the usual English for holding one's life in one's hands; Literal keeps "palm".

decisions.choice: put myself in danger like this
alternatives: take my flesh in my teeth
decisions.reason: Readable explains the first picture (m1) and keeps the second, which English also uses.

decisions.choice: "jugándome la vida"
decisions.reason: "Jugarse la vida" is the Spanish idiom for risking one's life.

decisions.choice: « en risquant ma propre vie »
alternatives: « en prenant ma vie dans mes mains »
decisions.reason: French has no idiom of holding one's life in one's hands for risking it, so Readable says it plainly.

decisions.choice: pondo a minha vida em jogo
alternatives: pondo a minha vida nas minhas próprias mãos
decisions.reason: The English Readable keeps the second picture because English "take one's life into one's hands" means to risk it; Portuguese "ter a vida nas mãos" does not, so Readable says "em jogo", the Portuguese for a life at risk (m1). Literal and Balanced keep the Hebrew picture.

source.text: הֵ֣ן יִ֭קְטְלֵנִי ל֣וֹ אֲיַחֵ֑ל אַךְ־דְּ֝רָכַ֗י אֶל־פָּנָ֥יו אוֹכִֽיחַ׃

records.literal_gloss: Look! he will kill me; for him I will wait; nevertheless my ways to his face I will argue.

en.L: Look, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will kill me; for {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} I will wait; \q nevertheless I will argue my ways to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} face.
en.B: Even if {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} kills me, I will hope in {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}; \q still, I will defend my ways to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} face.
en.R: God may kill me, but I will still hope in {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. \q Even so, I will defend myself in front of {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.

es.L: He aquí, {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} me matará; a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} esperaré; \q no obstante, argumentaré mis caminos ante {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} rostro.
es.B: Aunque {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} me quite la vida, seguiré esperando en {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}; \q aun así, defenderé mi conducta cara a cara ante {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.
es.R: Dios puede quitarme la vida, pero yo seguiré esperando en {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}. \q Aun así, me defenderé delante de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.

fr.L: Voici, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} me tuera ; c’est {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} que j’attendrai ; \q pourtant je défendrai mes voies devant {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} face.
fr.B: Même s’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} me tue, j’espérerai en {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} ; \q malgré tout, je défendrai ma conduite face à {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.
fr.R: Dieu peut bien me tuer, j’espérerai encore en {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. \q Malgré tout, je me défendrai devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.

sw.L: Tazama, {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} ataniua; {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} nitamngoja; \q hata hivyo nitazitetea njia zangu mbele ya uso {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}.
sw.B: Hata akiniua, nitamtumaini {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}}; \q lakini nitaitetea mienendo yangu mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.
sw.R: Mungu anaweza kuniua, lakini bado nitamtumaini {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}}. \q Hata hivyo, nitajitetea mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.

vi.L: Này, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ giết tôi; tôi sẽ trông đợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q dù vậy, tôi sẽ biện luận đường lối mình trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Dù {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} có giết tôi, tôi vẫn hy vọng nơi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q nhưng tôi vẫn sẽ bênh vực đường lối mình trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Đức Chúa Trời có thể giết tôi, nhưng tôi vẫn trông cậy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Dù vậy, tôi vẫn sẽ tự bào chữa trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 보라, 그분께서 나를 죽이실 것이다. 그분을 나는 기다리겠다. \q 그래도 내 길을 그분 얼굴 앞에서 변론하겠다.
ko.B: 그분께서 나를 죽이신다 해도 나는 그분께 소망을 두겠다. \q 그래도 내 행실을 그분 앞에서 변호하겠다.
ko.R: 하나님께서 나를 죽이실지도 모른다. 그래도 나는 그분께 소망을 두겠다. \q 어찌 되든 나는 그분 앞에서 나 자신을 변호하겠다.

pt.L: Eis que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} me matará; por {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} esperarei; \q todavia, diante da {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} face sustentarei os meus caminhos.
pt.B: Ainda que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} me mate, {{deity_pronoun:nele|Nele}} esperarei; \q mesmo assim, vou defender a minha conduta diante {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}.
pt.R: Deus pode me matar, mas ainda vou esperar {{deity_pronoun:nele|Nele}}. \q Mesmo assim, vou me defender na frente {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}.

decisions.choice: to him (read), not "not" (written)
alternatives: "I have no hope": Look, he will kill me; I have no hope; yet I will argue my ways to his face
decisions.reason: Here the written text (ketiv) and the reading tradition (qere) differ. The consonants are written as "not" (lo'); the scribes' note directs the word to be read as "to him" (lo), which sounds the same. The word data follows the reading, so the written "not" has no token of its own. With "to him" Job says he will still wait for God, or hope in him, though God kill him. With "not" he says he has no hope, but will argue his case anyway. The written form fits the run of verses 13-14, where Job expects to die for speaking; the reading fits verse 16, where he hopes that his boldness will save him. Both are old: the reading is how the verse was recited in the synagogue and became the well-known "though he slay me, yet will I trust in him". This translation follows the reading, as the word data does.

decisions.choice: wait: wait for, hope in
decisions.reason: The verb (yachal) means to wait with expectation, to hope (6:11; 14:14; Psalm 130:5). With "for him" it can mean hoping in God. Some take it in a darker sense, that Job waits for the blow; the sense of hope is the usual one.

decisions.choice: Look, he will kill me: Job faces the likely outcome
decisions.reason: The word hen is usually "look", but it can introduce a condition ("if"). Either way Job reckons with being put to death for bringing his case.

decisions.choice: nevertheless I will argue: Job will still make his case
decisions.reason: The word 'akh means "yet" or "only": whatever God does, Job will still plead his case. The verb is the court word yakhach of verses 3 and 10. "My ways" means his conduct, his whole way of life.

decisions.choice: Even if he kills me / God may kill me
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable express what Job faces as a possibility he accepts (m3); Literal keeps "Look".

decisions.choice: « c'est lui que j'attendrai », following the read text "to him" (m1)
alternatives: « je n'ai pas d'espoir » (the written text "not")
decisions.reason: The French follows the reading the meaning decision chooses; the line is drafted from the Hebrew, not from a familiar version.

decisions.choice: por ele esperarei (L); nele esperarei (B); vou esperar nele (R)
decisions.reason: Portuguese follows the reading tradition (qere) "to him", as the meaning decision and the English do (m1), with "esperar" in its sense of hoping (m2). The written text "not" would give "já não tenho esperança", the reading of some Portuguese versions; that alternative is in the footnote of m1.

decisions.choice: Ainda que ele me mate
decisions.reason: Balanced puts what Job faces as a possibility he accepts (m3), as the English does. The line is short and well known; its second half is worded afresh ("vou defender a minha conduta"), not in a familiar version's words.

source.text: גַּם־הוּא־לִ֥י לִֽישׁוּעָ֑ה כִּי־לֹ֥א לְ֝פָנָ֗יו חָנֵ֥ף יָבֽוֹא׃

records.literal_gloss: Also that [is] for me for salvation, for not before him a godless [one] will come.

en.L: Also this [will be] my salvation, \q for a godless [man] would not come before {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.B: This too will turn out for my deliverance, \q since no godless person would come before {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.R: This may even be what saves me, \q because no one who turns away from God would dare to stand before {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.

es.L: También esto [será] mi salvación, \q porque un impío no vendría delante de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.
es.B: Esto también resultará en mi liberación, \q pues ningún impío se presentaría ante {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.
es.R: Esto hasta podría ser lo que me salve, \q porque nadie que se aparta de Dios se atrevería a presentarse ante {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.

fr.L: Cela même [sera] mon salut, \q car un impie ne viendrait pas devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.
fr.B: Cela aussi tournera à ma délivrance, \q car aucun impie ne viendrait devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.
fr.R: C’est peut-être même cela qui me sauvera, \q car celui qui se détourne de Dieu n’oserait pas se présenter devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.

sw.L: Tena hili [litakuwa] wokovu wangu, \q kwa maana asiyemcha Mungu hangekuja mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.
sw.B: Hili nalo litageuka kuwa kuokolewa kwangu, \q kwa kuwa hakuna asiyemcha Mungu angekuja mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.
sw.R: Huenda hili ndilo litakaloniokoa, \q kwa sababu hakuna mtu aliyemwacha Mungu angethubutu kusimama mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.

vi.L: Cũng chính điều đó [sẽ là] sự cứu rỗi cho tôi, \q vì kẻ vô đạo sẽ không đến trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Chính điều ấy cũng sẽ đem lại sự giải cứu cho tôi, \q vì kẻ vô đạo sẽ không đến trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Có khi chính điều đó lại cứu tôi, \q vì không kẻ nào đã quay lưng với Đức Chúa Trời lại dám đứng trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 그것 또한 나의 구원이 [될 것이다]. \q 경건하지 않은 자는 그분 앞에 나아가지 못할 것이기 때문이다.
ko.B: 이것 역시 나를 구해 낼 것이다. \q 경건하지 않은 자는 그분 앞에 나아가지 않을 것이기 때문이다.
ko.R: 어쩌면 바로 이것이 나를 살릴지도 모른다. \q 하나님을 떠난 사람은 감히 그분 앞에 서지 못할 것이기 때문이다.

pt.L: Também isto [será] a minha salvação, \q pois um ímpio não chegaria diante {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}.
pt.B: Isso também vai resultar no meu livramento, \q já que nenhum ímpio se apresentaria diante {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}.
pt.R: Isso pode até ser o que vai me salvar, \q porque ninguém que vive sem Deus teria coragem de ficar diante {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}.

decisions.choice: this: Job's daring to come before God
decisions.reason: "This" (or "he", the same word) points to what Job has just resolved: to bring his case to God's face. A godless man would not dare to do so; that Job dares is itself a sign that he is not godless. Some read the word as "he": God himself will be Job's salvation. The first fits the reason given in the second line.

decisions.choice: salvation: rescue, being set right
decisions.reason: The word (yeshu'ah) means rescue or deliverance from danger. Here it is the outcome Job hopes for: to be shown innocent and saved.

decisions.choice: godless: one who has turned from God
decisions.reason: The word (chanef) describes a person who is profane, cut off from God. Bildad had said that the hope of the godless will perish (8:13); Job answers that a godless man would never come before God as he means to do.

decisions.choice: deliverance
decisions.reason: Balanced says "deliverance" because Job means being rescued and shown innocent, not salvation in its later full sense (m2).

decisions.choice: no one who turns away from God would dare
alternatives: a godless person would not come
decisions.reason: Readable explains "godless" (m3) and adds "dare" to bring out the boldness of coming before God.

source.text: שִׁמְע֣וּ שָׁ֭מוֹעַ מִלָּתִ֑י וְ֝אַֽחֲוָתִ֗י בְּאָזְנֵיכֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Hear carefully my word, and my declaration in your ears.

en.L: Listen carefully to my word, \q and [let] my declaration [be] in your ears.
en.B: Listen closely to what I say; \q let my declaration reach your ears.
en.R: Listen carefully to what I am saying. \q Let my words sink in.

es.L: {{plural_you:Escuchen|Escuchad}} atentamente mi palabra, \q y [esté] mi declaración en {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} oídos.
es.B: {{plural_you:Escuchen|Escuchad}} bien lo que digo; \q que mi declaración llegue a {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} oídos.
es.R: {{plural_you:Escuchen|Escuchad}} con atención lo que estoy diciendo. \q {{plural_you:Dejen que mis palabras les lleguen|Dejad que mis palabras os lleguen}} hondo.

fr.L: Écoutez attentivement ma parole, \q et [que] ma déclaration [soit] dans vos oreilles.
fr.B: Écoutez bien ce que je dis ; \q que ma déclaration parvienne à vos oreilles.
fr.R: Écoutez attentivement ce que je dis. \q Laissez mes paroles pénétrer en vous.

sw.L: Sikieni kwa makini neno langu, \q na tamko langu [liwe] masikioni mwenu.
sw.B: Sikilizeni kwa makini ninachosema; \q tamko langu na liyafikie masikio yenu.
sw.R: Sikilizeni kwa makini ninachosema. \q Maneno yangu yawaingie mioyoni.

vi.L: Hãy nghe kỹ lời tôi, \q và [để] lời tuyên bố của tôi [vào] tai các anh.
vi.B: Hãy lắng nghe kỹ điều tôi nói; \q hãy để lời tôi trình bày lọt vào tai các anh.
vi.R: Hãy chú ý nghe điều tôi đang nói. \q Hãy để lời tôi thấm vào lòng các anh.

ko.L: 내 말을 잘 들으시오. \q 내가 밝히는 것이 그대들의 귀에 [들어가게 하시오].
ko.B: 내가 하는 말을 귀담아들으시오. \q 내가 밝히는 말이 그대들의 귀에 닿게 하시오.
ko.R: 내가 하는 말을 잘 들으시오. \q 내 말을 마음에 새기시오.

pt.L: Ouçam atentamente a minha palavra, \q e [esteja] a minha declaração nos ouvidos de vocês.
pt.B: Escutem com atenção o que eu digo; \q que a minha declaração chegue aos ouvidos de vocês.
pt.R: Escutem bem o que estou dizendo. \q Prestem atenção nas minhas palavras.

decisions.choice: Hear carefully: the verb doubled for emphasis
decisions.reason: The verb "hear" is repeated in two forms, a strong call to listen. Job speaks again to the friends before he turns to God.

decisions.choice: declaration: what Job sets out to state
decisions.reason: The word ('achvah) is found only here. It comes from a verb meaning "declare" that is used several times in Job (15:17; 32:6).

decisions.choice: Let my words sink in
alternatives: let my declaration be in your ears
decisions.reason: Readable uses an everyday phrase for taking words to heart.

source.text: הִנֵּה־נָ֭א עָרַ֣כְתִּי מִשְׁפָּ֑ט יָ֝דַ֗עְתִּי כִּֽי־אֲנִ֥י אֶצְדָּֽק׃

records.literal_gloss: Look please, I have set in order a case; I know that I will be in the right.

en.L: Look now, I have set out [my] case; \q I know that I will be in the right.
en.B: See now, I have prepared my case; \q I know that I will be vindicated.
en.R: Look, my case is ready. \q I know that I will be proved right.

es.L: He aquí ahora, he ordenado [mi] causa; \q sé que yo seré hallado justo.
es.B: {{plural_you:Miren|Mirad}}, he preparado mi causa; \q sé que seré declarado inocente.
es.R: {{plural_you:Miren|Mirad}}, mi caso está listo. \q Sé que se me dará la razón.

fr.L: Voici donc, j’ai exposé [ma] cause ; \q je sais que moi, je serai reconnu juste.
fr.B: Voyez, j’ai préparé ma cause ; \q je sais que j’obtiendrai justice.
fr.R: Voici, ma cause est prête. \q Je sais que l’on me donnera raison.

sw.L: Tazama sasa, nimelipanga shauri [langu]; \q najua kwamba mimi nitaonekana kuwa na haki.
sw.B: Tazameni sasa, nimeiandaa kesi yangu; \q najua kwamba nitathibitishwa kuwa sina hatia.
sw.R: Tazameni, kesi yangu iko tayari. \q Najua kwamba nitaonekana niko sahihi.

vi.L: Này, tôi đã trình bày [vụ] kiện; \q tôi biết rằng tôi sẽ được xưng là công chính.
vi.B: Này, tôi đã chuẩn bị xong vụ kiện của mình; \q tôi biết tôi sẽ được minh oan.
vi.R: Này, vụ kiện của tôi đã sẵn sàng. \q Tôi biết tôi sẽ được chứng minh là đúng.

ko.L: 보시오, 내가 [내] 송사를 갖추어 놓았소. \q 나는 내가 의롭다고 인정받을 줄 아오.
ko.B: 보시오, 내가 내 소송을 준비해 두었소. \q 나는 내가 무죄로 판명될 것을 아오.
ko.R: 보시오, 내 사정은 다 준비되었소. \q 나는 내가 옳다는 것이 드러날 줄 아오.

pt.L: Eis agora, preparei [a minha] causa; \q sei que terei razão.
pt.B: Vejam, eu preparei a minha causa; \q sei que serei declarado inocente.
pt.R: Vejam, a minha causa está pronta. \q Sei que vou provar que tenho razão.

decisions.choice: set in order a case: prepare a legal case
decisions.reason: The verb ('arakh) means to arrange in order, as troops for battle or a table for a meal. With "case" (mishpat) it means to lay out a lawsuit point by point (23:4).

decisions.choice: be in the right: be found innocent in court
decisions.reason: The verb (tsadaq) here has its legal sense: to be in the right, to win the case and be declared innocent. Job does not claim to be without any sin (verse 26); he claims he has done nothing to deserve what has come on him.

decisions.choice: be vindicated
decisions.reason: Balanced uses "vindicated", the English word for being shown to be in the right (m2).

source.text: מִי־ה֭וּא יָרִ֣יב עִמָּדִ֑י כִּֽי־עַתָּ֖ה אַחֲרִ֣ישׁ וְאֶגְוָֽע׃

records.literal_gloss: Who [is] he [who] will contend with me? For now I would be silent and expire.

en.L: Who is he [who] will contend with me? \q For then I would be silent and die.
en.B: Who is there that can bring a case against me? \q If anyone can, I will be silent and die.
en.R: Can anyone prove me wrong? \q If so, I will keep quiet and die.

es.L: ¿Quién es el [que] contenderá conmigo? \q Porque entonces callaría y expiraría.
es.B: ¿Quién podrá entablar pleito contra mí? \q Si alguien puede, callaré y moriré.
es.R: ¿Puede alguien demostrar que estoy equivocado? \q Si es así, me quedaré callado y moriré.

fr.L: Qui est-ce [qui] plaidera contre moi ? \q Car alors je me tairais et j’expirerais.
fr.B: Qui donc pourrait m’intenter un procès ? \q Si quelqu’un le peut, je me tairai et mourrai.
fr.R: Quelqu’un peut-il prouver que j’ai tort ? \q Si oui, je me tairai et je mourrai.

sw.L: Ni nani [yule] atakayeshindana nami? \q Kwa maana hapo ningenyamaza na kukata roho.
sw.B: Ni nani awezaye kunifungulia mashtaka? \q Kama yupo, nitanyamaza na kufa.
sw.R: Je, kuna mtu awezaye kuthibitisha kwamba nimekosea? \q Ikiwa yupo, nitanyamaza na kufa.

vi.L: Ai là kẻ sẽ tranh tụng với tôi? \q Vì khi ấy tôi sẽ im lặng và tắt hơi.
vi.B: Có ai kiện cáo được tôi chăng? \q Nếu có, tôi sẽ im lặng và chết.
vi.R: Có ai chứng minh được tôi sai không? \q Nếu có, tôi sẽ im miệng và chết.

ko.L: 나와 변론할 자가 누구요? \q 그러면 내가 잠잠하고 숨을 거두겠소.
ko.B: 누가 나를 고소할 수 있겠소? \q 그럴 수 있는 자가 있다면 나는 입을 다물고 죽겠소.
ko.R: 누가 내가 틀렸다는 것을 밝힐 수 있겠소? \q 그렇다면 나는 입을 다물고 죽겠소.

pt.L: Quem é que contenderá comigo? \q Pois então eu me calaria e expiraria.
pt.B: Quem pode mover uma causa contra mim? \q Se alguém puder, eu me calarei e morrerei.
pt.R: Alguém pode provar que estou errado? \q Se puder, vou ficar quieto e morrer.

decisions.choice: then I would be silent and die: if anyone wins the case, Job will accept death
alternatives: if I kept silent now, I would die
decisions.reason: The second line is usually read as Job's oath: if anyone can prove a case against him, he will say no more and die. It can also mean that he must speak, because if he kept silent now he would die. The words allow both; the first fits the confidence of verse 18.

decisions.choice: contend: bring a legal case
decisions.reason: The verb (rib) is the lawsuit word of verse 8. Job challenges anyone, God included, to bring charges against him.

decisions.choice: If anyone can / If so
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable spell out the condition that "for then" implies (m1).

source.text: אַךְ־שְׁ֭תַּיִם אַל־תַּ֣עַשׂ עִמָּדִ֑י אָ֥ז מִ֝פָּנֶ֗יךָ לֹ֣א אֶסָּתֵֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: Only two [things] do not do with me; then from your face not I will hide.

en.L: Only two [things] do not do to me; \q then I will not hide from {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} face.
en.B: Only do not do two things to me, \q and then I will not hide from {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} presence.
en.R: God, there are just two things I ask {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} not to do. \q Then I will not hide from {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.

es.L: Solo dos [cosas] no hagas conmigo; \q entonces no me esconderé de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} rostro.
es.B: Solo no me hagas dos cosas, \q y entonces no me esconderé de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} presencia.
es.R: Dios, solo hay dos cosas que {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} pido que no hagas. \q Entonces no me esconderé de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.

fr.L: Seulement, ne me fais pas deux [choses] ; \q alors je ne me cacherai pas de devant {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} face.
fr.B: Seulement, ne me fais pas ces deux choses, \q et alors je ne me cacherai pas loin de {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} présence.
fr.R: Dieu, il y a seulement deux choses que je {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} demande de ne pas faire. \q Alors je ne me cacherai pas de {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}.

sw.L: Ila mambo mawili usinitendee; \q ndipo sitajificha mbele ya uso {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}.
sw.B: Ila usinitendee mambo mawili tu, \q ndipo sitajificha mbele {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.R: Ee Mungu, kuna mambo mawili tu ninayokuomba usinitendee. \q Ndipo sitajificha mbali na {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}.

vi.L: Chỉ xin đừng làm hai [điều] với con; \q thì con sẽ không trốn khỏi mặt Chúa.
vi.B: Chỉ xin Chúa đừng làm hai điều này với con, \q rồi con sẽ không lẩn tránh mặt Chúa.
vi.R: Lạy Đức Chúa Trời, con chỉ xin Chúa đừng làm hai điều. \q Rồi con sẽ không trốn tránh Chúa.

ko.L: 다만 두 가지를 제게 하지 마십시오. \q 그러면 제가 주님의 얼굴을 피하여 숨지 않겠습니다.
ko.B: 다만 두 가지만은 제게 하지 마십시오. \q 그러면 제가 주님 앞에서 숨지 않겠습니다.
ko.R: 하나님, 제가 주님께 하지 말아 주십사 하고 부탁드리는 것은 두 가지뿐입니다. \q 그러면 제가 주님을 피해 숨지 않겠습니다.

pt.L: Somente duas [coisas] não faças comigo; \q então não me esconderei da {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} face.
pt.B: Somente não me faças duas coisas, \q e então não me esconderei da {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} presença.
pt.R: Ó Deus, há só duas coisas que {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} peço que não faças. \q Então não vou me esconder de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.

decisions.choice: Job now speaks to God directly
decisions.reason: From here to the end of chapter 14 Job speaks to God ("you" singular), not to the friends. The two things he asks are named in verse 21.

decisions.choice: hide from your face: shrink from meeting God
decisions.reason: To hide from someone's face is to avoid meeting them, as Adam hid from God (Genesis 3:8). If God grants the two requests, Job will come forward and face him.

decisions.choice: God
decisions.reason: Readable adds "God" so that the reader knows whom Job now speaks to (m1).

decisions.choice: Job to God: "Chúa" for "you" and "con" for himself
decisions.reason: Job now speaks to God directly (m1). He addresses God as "Chúa" and calls himself "con", as the laments of the Psalms do; his tone is bitter, and "tôi" would also be possible.

decisions.choice: Job to God in 합쇼체, with "주님" and "저"
decisions.reason: From verse 20 Job speaks to God (m1), so Korean moves from the 하오체 used with the friends to the 합쇼체 of prayer.

source.text: כַּ֭פְּךָ מֵעָלַ֣י הַרְחַ֑ק וְ֝אֵ֥מָתְךָ֗ אַֽל־תְּבַעֲתַֽנִּי׃

records.literal_gloss: Your palm from on me put far away, and dread of you not let it terrify me.

en.L: Put {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} palm far from upon me, \q and let not dread of {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} terrify me.
en.B: Take {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} hand away from me, \q and do not let the terror of {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} frighten me.
en.R: Take {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} heavy hand off me, \q and do not let fear of {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} overwhelm me.

es.L: Aleja {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} palma de sobre mí, \q y no me aterre el pavor de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.
es.B: Aparta de mí {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} mano, \q y no dejes que el terror de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} me espante.
es.R: Quita de encima de mí {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pesada mano, \q y no dejes que el miedo a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} me abrume.

fr.L: Éloigne {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} paume de dessus moi, \q et que la frayeur de {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} ne m’épouvante pas.
fr.B: Retire {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} main de dessus moi, \q et que la terreur que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} inspires ne m’effraie pas.
fr.R: Enlève de sur moi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} main si lourde, \q et ne laisse pas la peur de {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} m’écraser.

sw.L: Ondoa kiganja {{deity_pronoun:chako|Chako}} mbali juu yangu, \q na hofu {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} isinitishe.
sw.B: Uondoe mkono {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} juu yangu, \q wala usiache kitisho {{deity_pronoun:chako|Chako}} kinitie hofu.
sw.R: Uuondoe juu yangu mkono {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} mzito, \q wala usiache hofu {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} inilemee.

vi.L: Xin đặt bàn tay Chúa xa khỏi con, \q và đừng để sự kinh hãi về Chúa làm con khiếp sợ.
vi.B: Xin Chúa rút tay Chúa khỏi con, \q và đừng để nỗi kinh hãi về Chúa làm con khiếp sợ.
vi.R: Xin Chúa cất bàn tay nặng nề của Chúa khỏi con, \q và đừng để nỗi sợ hãi Chúa đè bẹp con.

ko.L: 주님의 손바닥을 제게서 멀리 거두시고, \q 주님에 대한 두려움이 저를 떨게 하지 않게 하십시오.
ko.B: 주님의 손을 제게서 거두어 주시고, \q 주님에 대한 공포가 저를 두렵게 하지 않게 해 주십시오.
ko.R: 제게 얹으신 무거운 손을 거두어 주십시오. \q 주님이 두려워 제가 짓눌리지 않게 해 주십시오.

pt.L: Afasta de sobre mim a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} palma, \q e que o pavor de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} não me espante.
pt.B: Tira de cima de mim a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} mão, \q e não permitas que o pavor de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} me aterrorize.
pt.R: Tira de cima de mim a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} mão pesada, \q e não deixes que o medo de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} tome conta de mim.

decisions.choice: your palm: God's hand pressing on Job
decisions.reason: God's hand stands for his power. Job feels it as a blow that has struck him (19:21) and as a weight that crushes him. He asks God to lift it, so that he can speak freely.

decisions.choice: dread of you: the same request as 9:34
decisions.reason: Job asked for the same two things in 9:34: that God would take his rod away and stop terrifying him. Then he could speak without fear. These are the "two things" of verse 20.

decisions.choice: hand
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "hand", as English does for a person's power; Readable adds "heavy" for the weight Job feels (m1). Literal keeps "palm".

source.text: וּ֭קְרָא וְאָנֹכִ֣י אֶֽעֱנֶ֑ה אֽוֹ־אֲ֝דַבֵּ֗ר וַהֲשִׁיבֵֽנִי׃

records.literal_gloss: And call, and I will answer; or I will speak, and reply to me.

en.L: And call, and I will answer; \q or I will speak, and reply to me.
en.B: Then call me, and I will answer; \q or let me speak, and {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} answer me.
en.R: Then call me to court, and I will answer. \q Or let me speak first, and {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} answer me.

es.L: Y llama, y yo responderé; \q o hablaré yo, y respóndeme.
es.B: Llámame entonces, y yo responderé; \q o déjame hablar, y {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} respóndeme.
es.R: Entonces llámame a juicio, y yo responderé. \q O déjame hablar primero, y {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} me respondes.

fr.L: Et appelle, et moi je répondrai ; \q ou je parlerai, et réplique-moi.
fr.B: Puis appelle-moi, et je répondrai ; \q ou bien je parlerai, et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me répondras.
fr.R: Puis convoque-moi au tribunal, et je répondrai. \q Ou laisse-moi parler le premier, et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me répondras.

sw.L: Kisha uite, nami nitajibu; \q au mimi nitasema, nawe unijibu.
sw.B: Kisha uniite, nami nitajibu; \q au uniache niseme, {{deity_pronoun:nawe|Nawe}} unijibu.
sw.R: Kisha uniite mahakamani, nami nitajibu. \q Au uniache niseme kwanza, {{deity_pronoun:nawe|Nawe}} unijibu.

vi.L: Rồi xin [Chúa] gọi, và con sẽ thưa; \q hoặc con sẽ nói, và xin [Chúa] đáp lời con.
vi.B: Rồi xin Chúa gọi con, con sẽ thưa; \q hoặc để con nói, rồi Chúa đáp lời con.
vi.R: Rồi xin Chúa gọi con ra tòa, con sẽ trả lời. \q Hoặc để con nói trước, rồi Chúa trả lời con.

ko.L: 그리고 부르십시오. 제가 대답하겠습니다. \q 아니면 제가 말씀드릴 테니 제게 대답하십시오.
ko.B: 그런 다음 저를 부르십시오. 제가 대답하겠습니다. \q 아니면 제가 말씀드리게 하시고 주님께서 제게 대답해 주십시오.
ko.R: 그런 다음 저를 재판정에 부르십시오. 제가 대답하겠습니다. \q 아니면 제가 먼저 말씀드리게 하시고 주님께서 대답해 주십시오.

pt.L: E chama, e eu responderei; \q ou eu falarei, e responde-me.
pt.B: Então me chama, e eu responderei; \q ou deixa-me falar, e {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me respondes.
pt.R: Então me chama ao tribunal, e eu vou responder. \q Ou deixa que eu fale primeiro, e {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me respondes.

decisions.choice: call and answer: the two sides of a court case
decisions.reason: In a lawsuit one side calls or speaks first and the other answers. Job offers God either part: God may summon him and he will reply, or he will state his case and God may reply. Earlier he feared that he could never answer God (9:3, 14-16).

decisions.choice: call me to court ... speak first
decisions.reason: Readable makes the court setting plain (m1).

source.text: כַּמָּ֣ה לִ֭י עֲוֺנ֣וֹת וְחַטָּא֑וֹת פִּֽשְׁעִ֥י וְ֝חַטָּאתִ֗י הֹדִיעֵֽנִי׃

records.literal_gloss: How many [are] to me iniquities and sins? My transgression and my sin make known to me.

en.L: How many [are] my iniquities and sins? \q Make known to me my transgression and my sin.
en.B: How many wrongs and sins have I committed? \q Show me my offense and my sin.
en.R: How many wrongs and sins have I done? \q Tell me what I did wrong.

es.L: ¿Cuántas [son] mis iniquidades y pecados? \q Hazme conocer mi transgresión y mi pecado.
es.B: ¿Cuántas faltas y pecados he cometido? \q Muéstrame mi ofensa y mi pecado.
es.R: ¿Cuántas faltas y pecados he cometido? \q Dime qué hice mal.

fr.L: Combien [ai-je] d’iniquités et de péchés ? \q Fais-moi connaître ma transgression et mon péché.
fr.B: Combien de fautes et de péchés ai-je commis ? \q Montre-moi mon offense et mon péché.
fr.R: Combien de fautes et de péchés ai-je commis ? \q Dis-moi ce que j’ai fait de mal.

sw.L: Maovu yangu na dhambi zangu [ni] mangapi? \q Unijulishe kosa langu na dhambi yangu.
sw.B: Nimefanya makosa na dhambi ngapi? \q Unionyeshe hatia yangu na dhambi yangu.
sw.R: Nimefanya makosa na dhambi ngapi? \q Uniambie nilichokosea.

vi.L: Gian ác và tội lỗi của con [là] bao nhiêu? \q Xin cho con biết sự vi phạm và tội lỗi của con.
vi.B: Con đã phạm bao nhiêu lỗi lầm và tội lỗi? \q Xin chỉ cho con thấy sự sai phạm và tội lỗi của con.
vi.R: Con đã làm bao nhiêu điều sai và tội lỗi? \q Xin cho con biết con đã làm gì sai.

ko.L: 제 죄악과 죄가 얼마나 [됩니까]? \q 제 허물과 제 죄를 제게 알게 하십시오.
ko.B: 제가 저지른 잘못과 죄가 얼마나 됩니까? \q 제 허물과 죄를 보여 주십시오.
ko.R: 제가 잘못한 것과 죄지은 것이 얼마나 됩니까? \q 제가 무엇을 잘못했는지 말씀해 주십시오.

pt.L: Quantas [são] as minhas iniquidades e pecados? \q Faze-me saber a minha transgressão e o meu pecado.
pt.B: Quantas maldades e pecados cometi? \q Mostra-me a minha ofensa e o meu pecado.
pt.R: Quantas coisas erradas e quantos pecados eu fiz? \q Mostra-me o que eu fiz de errado.

decisions.choice: iniquities, sins, transgression: the whole vocabulary of wrongdoing
decisions.reason: Three words are used. 'Avon is wrongdoing and the guilt it brings; chatta't is sin, failing to do what is right; pesha' is rebellion, a breach of loyalty. Together they name every kind of offense, as in Exodus 34:7.

decisions.choice: make known to me: Job asks for the charges
decisions.reason: In court the accused has the right to hear the charge. Job asks God to name the offenses that would explain his suffering, since he knows of none (verse 18).

decisions.choice: wrongs ... offense
decisions.reason: Balanced uses everyday words for 'avon and pesha'; Literal keeps the traditional terms (m1).

source.text: לָֽמָּה־פָנֶ֥יךָ תַסְתִּ֑יר וְתַחְשְׁבֵ֖נִי לְאוֹיֵ֣ב לָֽךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: Why your face do you hide, and count me as an enemy to you?

en.L: Why do {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} hide {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} face, \q and count me as an enemy to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}?
en.B: Why do {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} hide {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} face \q and treat me as {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} enemy?
en.R: Why do {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} turn away from me? \q Why do {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} treat me like {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} enemy?

es.L: ¿Por qué escondes {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} rostro, \q y me consideras enemigo para {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}?
es.B: ¿Por qué escondes {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} rostro \q y me tratas como a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} enemigo?
es.R: ¿Por qué {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} alejas de mí? \q ¿Por qué me tratas como a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} enemigo?

fr.L: Pourquoi caches-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} face, \q et me comptes-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pour un ennemi à {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} ?
fr.B: Pourquoi caches-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} face \q et me traites-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} comme {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} ennemi ?
fr.R: Pourquoi {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} détournes-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} de moi ? \q Pourquoi me traites-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} comme {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} ennemi ?

sw.L: Kwa nini unauficha uso {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, \q na kunihesabu kuwa adui {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}?
sw.B: Kwa nini unauficha uso {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} \q na kunitendea kama adui {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}?
sw.R: Kwa nini unanigeuzia mgongo? \q Kwa nini unanitendea kama adui {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}?

vi.L: Sao Chúa ẩn mặt Chúa, \q và kể con là kẻ thù của Chúa?
vi.B: Sao Chúa giấu mặt đi \q và đối xử với con như kẻ thù của Chúa?
vi.R: Sao Chúa quay mặt khỏi con? \q Sao Chúa đối xử với con như kẻ thù?

ko.L: 어찌하여 주님의 얼굴을 숨기시고, \q 저를 주님의 원수로 여기십니까?
ko.B: 어찌하여 주님의 얼굴을 가리시고 \q 저를 원수처럼 대하십니까?
ko.R: 왜 저를 외면하십니까? \q 왜 저를 원수처럼 대하십니까?

pt.L: Por que escondes a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} face \q e me consideras {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} inimigo?
pt.B: Por que escondes o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} rosto \q e me tratas como {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} inimigo?
pt.R: Por que {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} afastas de mim? \q Por que me tratas como se eu fosse {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} inimigo?

decisions.choice: hide your face: withdraw favor and help
decisions.reason: When God hides his face, he turns away and withholds his help (Deuteronomy 31:17-18; Psalm 13:2). Job feels abandoned by the God he wants to meet.

decisions.choice: enemy
decisions.reason: The word for "enemy" ('oyev) sounds close to Job's own name ('iyyov). Job feels that God treats him as an enemy (19:11; 33:10).

decisions.choice: turn away from me
decisions.reason: Readable explains the idiom (m1).

source.text: הֶעָלֶ֣ה נִדָּ֣ף תַּעֲר֑וֹץ וְאֶת־קַ֖שׁ יָבֵ֣שׁ תִּרְדֹּֽף׃

records.literal_gloss: ? A leaf driven will you terrify, and chaff dry will you pursue?

en.L: Will {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} terrify a driven leaf? \q And will {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} pursue dry chaff?
en.B: Will {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} frighten a leaf blown by the wind? \q Will {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} chase after dry straw?
en.R: Will {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} really frighten a leaf that the wind blows around? \q Will {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} chase after dry straw?

es.L: ¿Aterrarás {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} a una hoja arrastrada? \q ¿Y perseguirás {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} la paja seca?
es.B: ¿Vas a asustar {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} a una hoja llevada por el viento? \q ¿Perseguirás {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} la paja seca?
es.R: ¿De verdad vas a asustar a una hoja que el viento lleva de aquí para allá? \q ¿Vas a perseguir la paja seca?

fr.L: Veux-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} terrifier une feuille emportée ? \q Et poursuivras-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} de la paille sèche ?
fr.B: Veux-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} effrayer une feuille poussée par le vent ? \q Vas-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pourchasser de la paille sèche ?
fr.R: Vas-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} vraiment faire peur à une feuille que le vent fait tourbillonner ? \q Vas-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} courir après de la paille sèche ?

sw.L: Je, utalitisha jani linalopeperushwa? \q Na utayafuatia makapi makavu?
sw.B: Je, utalitisha jani linalopeperushwa na upepo? \q Je, utayafukuza majani makavu?
sw.R: Je, kweli utalitisha jani linalopeperushwa huku na huko na upepo? \q Je, utayafukuza majani makavu?

vi.L: Chúa sẽ làm kinh hãi một chiếc lá bị gió cuốn sao? \q Và Chúa sẽ đuổi theo trấu khô sao?
vi.B: Chúa muốn làm cho chiếc lá bị gió thổi phải khiếp sợ sao? \q Chúa sẽ đuổi theo cọng rơm khô sao?
vi.R: Chúa thật sự muốn dọa một chiếc lá bị gió thổi bay tứ tung sao? \q Chúa muốn đuổi theo cọng rơm khô sao?

ko.L: 주님께서 날리는 잎사귀를 두렵게 하시렵니까? \q 마른 겨를 쫓으시렵니까?
ko.B: 바람에 날리는 잎사귀를 주님께서 놀라게 하시렵니까? \q 마른 지푸라기를 뒤쫓으시렵니까?
ko.R: 바람에 이리저리 날리는 나뭇잎을 정말로 겁주시렵니까? \q 마른 지푸라기를 쫓아가시렵니까?

pt.L: Aterrorizarás uma folha arrastada? \q E perseguirás palha seca?
pt.B: Vais assustar uma folha levada pelo vento? \q Vais correr atrás de palha seca?
pt.R: Vais mesmo assustar uma folha que o vento leva de um lado para o outro? \q Vais correr atrás de palha seca?

decisions.choice: a driven leaf, dry chaff: Job's weakness
decisions.reason: A leaf blown by the wind and dry stubble are the weakest, lightest things there are (Leviticus 26:36; Psalm 1:4). Job asks why the Almighty should spend his power hunting something so small.

decisions.choice: dry straw
decisions.reason: The word (qash) is the dry stalks left after harvest. Balanced and Readable say "straw"; Literal keeps "chaff".

source.text: כִּֽי־תִכְתֹּ֣ב עָלַ֣י מְרֹר֑וֹת וְ֝תוֹרִישֵׁ֗נִי עֲוֺנ֥וֹת נְעוּרָֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: For you write against me bitter [things], and make me inherit [the] iniquities of my youth.

en.L: For {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} write bitter [things] against me, \q and make me inherit the iniquities of my youth.
en.B: For {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} write down bitter charges against me \q and make me pay for the sins of my youth.
en.R: You write down bitter charges against me. \q You make me suffer for the sins I did when I was young.

es.L: Porque {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} escribes contra mí [cosas] amargas, \q y me haces heredar las iniquidades de mi juventud.
es.B: Porque {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} escribes contra mí acusaciones amargas \q y me haces pagar los pecados de mi juventud.
es.R: Tú escribes contra mí acusaciones amargas. \q Me haces sufrir por los pecados que cometí cuando era joven.

fr.L: Car {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} écris contre moi des [choses] amères, \q et me fais hériter les iniquités de ma jeunesse.
fr.B: Car {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} rédiges contre moi des accusations amères \q et me fais payer les péchés de ma jeunesse.
fr.R: Tu écris contre moi des accusations amères. \q Tu me fais souffrir pour les péchés que j’ai commis quand j’étais jeune.

sw.L: Kwa maana {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} unaandika mambo machungu dhidi yangu, \q na kunirithisha maovu ya ujana wangu.
